title: linaria heterophylla subsp. gigantea
intro: Linaria heterophylla subsp. gigantea, commonly known as Toadflax or Large-flowered Toadflax, is a plant species in the family Plantaginaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Linaria heterophylla subsp. gigantea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of sedation, calming, and relaxation. The plant's therapeutic actions are thought to be due to its ability to modulate the nervous system and promote a sense of calm and well-being.
